limitations: How many pages the site has is unknown: URLs were found by following links from the pages fetched. Findings speak for the 64 discovered URL(s), not for pages the crawl did not find.

Headless browser rendering was not available in this environment; rendering-gap findings are based on a static-content heuristic only and are reported as suspected/insufficient_evidence rather than confirmed.
No external search provider was configured; claim corroboration and off-site footprint assessment were not checked this run (not the same as "nothing found").

Review and directory platforms (Trustpilot, G2, Google Business Profile and others) were not searched for the brand: they block automated clients, no search provider was configured, and the agent stage (AG-06) was not supplied. Only profiles linked from the site were considered.
Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) were not measured: the audit runs no browser and no PAGESPEED_API_KEY is configured. Web-vitals findings are estimates from markup patterns, not measurements.
Colour contrast and tap-target size were judged only where inline styles set them; colours and sizes from stylesheets need a browser to compute and were not assessed.

Agent check AG-01 (About-page concreteness) was not assessed: The packet-selected homepage opening is not assessable or complete; no eligible selected body opening is supplied. No substitute passage was fetched.

Agent check AG-02 (Independent mentions) was not assessed: The packet identity is unresolved; no packet-supported identity binding satisfying the search contract was available. Host search was not executed.

Agent check AG-03 (Independent contradiction) was not assessed: The packet identity is unresolved and no eligible bound claim/identity comparison was assessed. No independent conflict inspection was executed.
Agent check AG-04 (Facts drawn inside images) was not assessed: No full packet-listed image was viewed. Filename, alt text or header evidence is not a visual assessment.
Agent check AG-05 (Namesake ambiguity) was not assessed: The acquired target identity lacks the binding needed by the search contract. No namesake search was executed.

Agent check AG-06 (Review and profile opportunity) was not assessed: The acquired identity lacks the binding needed by the search contract. No platform search was executed; profile absence is not established.

confidence.method: min(sample_representativeness, observation_completeness, execution_penalty), where sample_representativeness = max(crawl_completeness, min(section_coverage, sample_size)), capped at 0.9 unless discovery_reliable is true, and crawl_completeness = pages_analyzed / pages_discovered; observation_completeness = (pages read in full + half of pages read in part) / (pages analyzed + challenged, waiting-room, timed-out and failed fetches). A weak link caps the score rather than being averaged out. identity_confidence is reported beside the score, not in it: it gates only the checks that depend on the brand's identity
confidence.interpretation: A heuristic rating of how far the report speaks for the whole site, not a calibrated probability. Each finding states its own confidence.

reasons.sample_representativeness: The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 1 of 64 discovered page(s) and reached 1 of 24 site section(s); how many pages the site has is unknown, so the discovered URLs may not be all of it.
reasons.observation_completeness: Not every page was read in full: 3 fetch(es) returned no readable content (a challenge, waiting room, timeout or failure).
reasons.identity_confidence: No Organization or Product JSON-LD was found on the analyzed pages, so the audit could not confirm which brand the site belongs to. Adding Organization markup raises this part.

confidence.explanation: Confidence is low (0.03). The weakest of its parts sets the score, here the page sample. The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 1 of 64 discovered page(s) and reached 1 of 24 site section(s); how many pages the site has is unknown, so the discovered URLs may not be all of it. Also weak: Not every page was read in full: 3 fetch(es) returned no readable content (a challenge, waiting room, timeout or failure). Brand identity (reported separately, not part of the score): No Organization or Product JSON-LD was found on the analyzed pages, so the audit could not confirm which brand the site belongs to. Adding Organization markup raises this part. The score rates how far the report speaks for the whole site; each finding has its own confidence and status, and a problem seen on a page is still real on that page.
